title: depenk.yml
description: Optional configuration for depenk, placed in the workspace root (the folder containing your repo clones).

repos.description: Which folders are scanned as repos.

paths.description: Explicit repo folders (relative to the workspace or absolute). When set, child-folder discovery is skipped.

include.description: Glob patterns on repo names to include (default ["*"]).

exclude.description: Glob patterns on repo names to exclude.

kindOverrides.description: Force a project's kind when the heuristics are wrong.

ignore.description: Glob patterns on project names to skip entirely.

producers.description: PackageId → repo name that produces it, to settle ambiguous producers.

httpWrappers.description: Teach depenk your in-house HTTP wrapper so its calls are linked with high confidence.

type.description: Glob on the wrapper's declared type name, e.g. "*.IApiHttpClient".

routeArgument.description: Zero-based index of the argument holding the route.

prefixes.description: Client project name → route prefix its base address adds (e.g. "/api").
